component.name: Apache Traffic Control
component.description: CDN control plane (Traffic Ops, Traffic Router, and related components). The project has been retired to the Apache Attic. Its security page documents the vulnerability reporting process and lists past disclosed vulnerabilities (CVE-2022-23206, CVE-2021-43350, CVE-2021-42009, CVE-2020-17522, CVE-2019-12405, CVE-2017-7670); it does not describe a threat model, trust boundaries, or in-scope/out-of-scope determinations.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it. The page contains only reporting instructions and past advisories.
